caption: The drawing depicts a single green glass goblet centered on a plain, light beige background. The goblet has a cylindrical bowl decorated with a repeating pattern of raised circular bumps arranged in vertical columns. The rim of the goblet is smooth and slightly rounded, with a band underneath separating the bowl from the short, sturdy stem. The stem is simple, tapering inward, and then flaring out to a broad, flat base that provides stability. The glass has consistent green coloring throughout, with areas of lighter and darker green suggesting light reflection and transparency. The drawing is enclosed by a thin, hand-drawn rectangular border, and there is a signature in the lower right corner.
title: Goblet
